title: YA SAARALLAH YA SAARALLAH
body:
ya saarallah ya saarallah
tasveer-e-payambar tha akber
atthara baras ka wo dilbar
wo seena e akbar par naiza aur sabr tera ibne zehra
<<MINI>>
wo karbobala wo karbobala
wo pyaas ki shiddat sukha gala
<<DIVIDER>>
thi dhoop ki shiddat aur garmi
uspar takleef-e-tashnalabi
pyaase bachou ki aah-o-buka aur sabr tera ibne zehra
<<MINI>>
wo karbobala wo karbobala
wo pyaas ki shiddat sukha gala
<<DIVIDER>>
jab nehr se paani leke chale
abbas ke shaane kaate gaye
tha saamne bhai ka laasha aur sabr tera ibne zehra
<<MINI>>
wo karbobala wo karbobala
wo pyaas ki shiddat sukha gala
dil khoon ke aansu rota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
banu ko dilaasa dena hai
hatou'n pe hai lasha asghar ka aur sabr tera ibne zehra
<<MINI>>
wo karbobala wo karbobala
wo pyaas ki shiddat sukha gala
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke dulaare qatl huwe
the bhaanje jo pyaare qatl huwe
us dukhiya ka sajda-e-shukrana aur sabr tera ibne zehra
<<MINI>>
wo karbobala wo karbobala
wo pyaas ki shiddat sukha gala
<<DIVIDER>>
wo leytna jalti reti par
seene pa rakhe dukhtar ka sar
beti se wo lamha rukhsat ka aur sabr tera ibne zehra
<<MINI>>
wo karbobala wo karbobala
wo pyaas ki shiddat sukha gala
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal ki fazaou'n me pehli
roya wo bilak kar jisne suni
ek bibi ke rone ki wo sada aur sabr tera ibne zehra
<<MINI>>
wo karbobala wo karbobala
wo pyaas ki shiddat sukha gala
<<DIVIDER>>
sadiyou'n se lahu rulwaate hain
jab yaad kisi ko aate hain
jo tere masayeb hai moula aur sabr tera ibne zehra
<<MINI>>
wo karbobala wo karbobala
wo pyaas ki shiddat sukha gala
<<DIVIDER>>
raazi ba reza zer e khanjar
naaza'n tujh par rabbe dawar
wo sajdaye haq me shukre khuda aur sabr tera ibne zehra
<<MINI>>

<<DIVIDER>>
besheer ka khoo'n tha chehre par
lipta huwa seene se asghar
dekha nahi manzar phir aisa aur sabr tera ibne zehra
<<MINI>>
wo karbobala wo karbobala

<<DIVIDER>>
laash usko bhala ham kaise kahe
sab jism ke tukde jamma kiye
allah re janaza qasim ka aur sabr tera ibne zehra
